name: LLM4AD
author: Optima-CityU
one_liner: Platform for LLM-driven algorithm design: search methods like EoH and FunSearch, scored by task evaluators.

loop.judged_by: task evaluation code (e.g. bin packing evaluators), run in separate processes with optional timeouts
loop.steers: search methods such as EoH and FunSearch pick which candidates are refined

not_proved: A good score shows an algorithm works on the benchmark instances used, not that it is the best possible or holds on other instances.
